paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Zohar, Vayikra 6a, which relates that he set out to sea and the ship sank, and he was saved through a miracle; and he is mentioned there, at the end of parashat Tetzaveh, together with Rashbi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ו. is interpreted as 6a if a daf locator; ס״פ is contextually end of parashat Tetzaveh. Neither Zohar locator has been freshly checked, and punctuation alone is not a verified modern folio side.

Sava means elder and remains transliterated. Rashbi preserves רשב״י as a conventional label, with Shimon bar Yochai a conventional name interpretation, not a new expanded-title/identity binding. Nehorai’s title remains R'. The headed subject sets out to sea, the ship sinks and he survives by a miracle; these are Hyman’s narrative claims.
